recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not resurrect or edit the retired Observation examples in core; any future genomics example code changes should be handled in the current Genomics Reporting IG or active current-spec genomics artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-11243 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for DSTU2 Observation examples. It asked that Observation example genetics 1 and Observation example genetics 2 stop displaying LOINC 55233-1 only as "Genetic analysis master panel" and instead use the longer explanatory panel display text.
initial_application: Git commit 5cc881e3f8 applied #11243 by changing source/observation/observation-example-genetics-1.xml and source/observation/observation-example-genetics-2.xml to use the requested explanatory display text for code 55233-1.
additional_context: Observation remains active in source/fhir.ini, but commit 3cfe12f1b4 later removed the outdated Clinical Genomics artifacts under Observation, DiagnosticReport, and ServiceRequest, including both examples targeted by this issue. The current genomics narrative points readers to the Genomics Reporting Implementation Guide. Current source searches found no tracked observation-example-genetics-1/2 files, no 55233-1, and no current example-genetics-1/2 references. Community searches found no direct FHIR-11243 conflict; a later Zulip thread about mCODE/Clinical Genomics code choices concerns IG-specific work rather than these retired core examples.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the issue was applied when the examples existed, and the affected examples are no longer in the current build/source scope.
